title: Autonomous Manufacturing Planner — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Converts product requirements into candidate processes, production sequences, and inspection plans. From what must be made, the planner proposes how: candidate processes, ordered production sequences, and the inspections that prove each step.
